commonPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Production transparent pixel-art animation sprite sheet for ONE original medieval mobile autobattler character. Image1 is STYLE MASTER shield knight; image2 is EDIT TARGET existing advanced character. Redesign target equipment to make its tier visibly stronger, keeping its class identity and human features. Match master's compact 2.5-head adult proportions, chunky crisp dark outline, discrete pixel clusters, broad metal highlights; matte cloth/leather. Do not copy any franchise. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha outside the sprites; ignore the reference's dark/brown background. NO background haze, smoke, ground shadows, checkerboard, labels, text, borders or watermark. Warm gold/teal faction trim but retain class color. Exactly1536x1024,6 columns x4 rows,256px cells. Exactly22 COMPLETE full-body drawings, all facing RIGHT. Four idle + two hit on row1; six alternating-foot walking on row2; six attack anticipation/action/recovery on row3; row4 first4 show stagger,kneel,collapse,lie still, last2cells EMPTY transparent. NEVER OMIT DEATH POSES. Human crown-to-sole height150px, foot baseline220 within each cell, centerx128. Weapons/flags may rise above head but human size stays constant. Every pose AND compact attack FX contained within cell x16..240,y12..240, separated by clear transparent gutters. Do not overlap neighboring cells. Same clothing and exactly same equipment count every frame, no hand swaps, no detached arms, no extra weapons/books. Arms stay connected to torso. Preserve bright intentional attack sparkle/arcs localized in FRONT of character; do not remove effects.

units.detail: GUARD KNIGHT intermediate evolution. Larger angular teal tower shield with a gold central kite emblem, squared gold pauldrons, layered knee armor, short teal mantle. Still clearly less ornate than a final commander. Closed gold visor and short teal plume. Exactly ONE sword held in far/right hand and ONE shield strapped to near/left forearm; no sword behind shield, no offhand sword. Compact bracing shield-bash attack toward RIGHT with a short blue-white protective arc; sword remains visibly low in its original hand throughout, no slash hand-switch.
